Add slide background inspector with duplicate-and-adjust and video trim

- Right-click Inspector for a slide's background: crop, fit, flip, colour, playback (loop, soft loop, speed, start/end) with draggable trim handles
- Duplicate and adjust copies the file (clone when supported) and re-links only that slide; Back to original re-links the source
- SHOW_LAYOUT history honors an explicit show/layout destination
- Document the inspector in AI_README.md
